LOBSTR 0.3.0 — Major update: Now uses runlobstr.com API, no setup required

- Simple sharing and posting: new `--public` and `--moltbook` flags for shareable scorecards and automatic Moltbook posts.

- BYOK "power user" mode with unlimited scans still available if API keys are set.
